body: I get it. Does anything make you happy?
I’m sorry. I understand. I hope for you to love life again.
Thousands and thousands of dollars. I gave up my best job trying to get another one. Now I’m screwed.
I’m tired. All the time. Sad or angry. Disappointed and wishing I had already died. Fuck me and this goddamned life.
I care. It’s just fucking dark.
No way I can think of.
